function.name: get_inventory_start_date
function.description: Read the account's configured inventory start date from application settings. This is the date initial counts are validated against and dated to. Returns { "inventory_start_date": "YYYY-MM-DD" } — null/absent means it has not been configured yet. A returned value is often a stale placeholder from account setup: treat it as a default to confirm against the source data or with the user, never as evidence of when stock was true. (GET /api/stock-takes/inventory-start-date)

function.name: set_inventory_start_date
function.description: Set the account's inventory start date. Only use this when it has not been configured yet and the user has confirmed the exact day — changing an existing one moves the line in the sand for order import, integration sync windows, and the effective accounting start date. Send nothing but inventory_start_date; the endpoint writes every property the body carries. (PUT /api/v2/settings/inventory)

inventory_start_date.description: The date inventory tracking begins (Y-m-d, interpreted in the account's timezone). Send null to clear it.

function.name: list_warehouses
function.description: List warehouses to resolve names to ids. A stock take's warehouse must be a standard (non-virtual) warehouse; check type/subtype and archived_at before using an id. (GET /api/v2/warehouses)

function.name: check_initial_uniqueness
function.description: Check whether an initial stock take already exists for a warehouse + condition. Returns { exists, stock_take_id }. Call before creating — only one initial count is allowed per pair. (POST /api/stock-takes/check-initial-uniqueness)

condition.description: Optional condition label the initial count applies to (e.g. "new", "used"). null covers the warehouse's default stock. Uniqueness is per warehouse + condition.

function.name: list_stock_takes
function.description: List stock takes with filters — use filter[is_initial_count]=1 to see which warehouses have already been counted before starting a multi-warehouse run. (GET /api/stock-takes/list)

filter[is_initial_count].description: 1 to return only initial counts, 0 for only non-initial counts.

function.name: resolve_skus
function.description: Bulk-resolve a list of SKUs or barcodes to products in one call (max 5000). Returns found, not_found, and skipped (wrong product type) — the way to turn a count sheet into product ids. (POST /api/stock-takes/resolve-skus)

skus.description: Array of SKU or barcode strings, matched case-insensitively against both columns and deduplicated. Max 5000 per request.

function.name: get_product_cost_options
function.description: Get cost options for a product at a warehouse — best_available_cogs (from FIFO history) and the product's default unit_cost, to 4 decimal places. Use to sanity-check a line's unit cost. (GET /api/stock-takes/product-cost-options)

function.name: create_stock_take
function.description: Create a stock take. For opening stock set is_initial_count true, mode full_count, and date_count to the inventory start date. Created as draft by default. (POST /api/stock-takes)

warehouse_id.description: The warehouse being counted. Must be a standard (non-virtual) warehouse.

is_initial_count.description: Marks this as the first-ever count for the warehouse. Set true for opening stock. Only one initial count is allowed per warehouse + condition.

mode.description: "full_count" (default) or "adjustment". An initial count is a full_count.

date_count.description: Count date (Y-m-d, account timezone). Defaults to today. **Ignored when is_initial_count is true** — the server pins an initial count to the configured inventory start date and silently discards whatever you send, so the created take can come back on a different day than you asked for. Read date_count off the response and check it. It cannot be changed once the take is finalized.

status.description: Defaults to "draft". Leave as draft and transition with initiate.

condition.description: Optional condition label (e.g. "new", "used"). Part of the initial-count uniqueness key.

is_blind.description: Blind count — hides system on-hand for uncounted items. Default false. Pointless for a first count of an empty warehouse; useful when counting a warehouse that already holds stock.

notes.description: Free-text note. Record the source of the count sheet here for audit. Capped at 255 characters by the column and NOT validated — a longer note returns a raw 500 ("Data too long for column 'notes'"), not a 422. Keep it short: source file, who supplied it, what you excluded.

items.description: Optional line items, addable later. Each item: { product_id (required, must exist), qty_counted (numeric, >= 0), unit_cost (optional numeric, >= 0 — an explicit 0 is kept and does not fall back to the product's cost), variance_reason (optional ENUM — one of receiving_error, picking_error, damage, mislabel, shrinkage, unknown; free text is rejected 422), lots (optional array for lot-tracked products) }.

function.name: bulk_insert_stock_take
function.description: Create a stock take and bulk-insert product ids as lines in one call. Returns stock_take_id. Quantities are not part of this call — set them afterwards with update-stock-take. (POST /api/stock-takes/bulk-insert)

ids.description: Array of product ids to add as lines (min 1 — a body without ids is rejected with 422).

is_initial_count.description: Flags the take as the warehouse's initial count and forces mode full_count.

function.name: update_stock_take
function.description: Update a stock take and its lines — add, update, or remove items and set counted quantities and unit costs before initiating. (PUT /api/stock-takes/{stock_take})

date_count.description: Re-date the count. Discarded outright on an initial count — its date is owned by the inventory start date setting, so fix that setting rather than the take.

notes.description: Free-text note. Max 255 characters (unvalidated — longer returns a 500).

items.description: Line items. Each: { product_id (required), qty_counted (numeric, >= 0), unit_cost (optional numeric, >= 0), variance_reason (optional ENUM: receiving_error, picking_error, damage, mislabel, shrinkage, unknown), to_delete (boolean, removes the line), lots (optional array of { batch_number, expiry_date, manufacture_date, quantity, lot_notes } — required per lot for lot-tracked products receiving newly found stock) }.

function.name: initiate_count
function.description: Transition a stock take from draft to open, taking the inventory snapshot for all its items. Required before finalize for a full_count. (POST /api/stock-takes/{stockTake}/initiate)

date_count.description: Retroactive count date (Y-m-d, account timezone, must be today or earlier). The resulting inventory movements, FIFO layers, and accounting journal are dated to it. Omit to date the count as of now. Returns 422 if in the future, 400 if it falls in a locked accounting period.

exclude_product_ids.description: Optional product ids to drop from the take before initiating.

function.name: finalize_stock_take
function.description: Finalize an open stock take — creates the inventory adjustments for every variance and closes it. This is the write that makes the opening stock real. Returns 400 on protected-inventory conflicts, insufficient stock, or if the take is not open. (POST /api/stock-takes/{stockTake}/finalize)

function.name: get_stock_take
function.description: Fetch a stock take with its items, warehouse, and (once closed) value_change and variance_direction. Use to review before finalizing and to verify afterwards. (GET /api/stock-takes/{stock_take})

function.name: reconciliation_preview
function.description: Preview what finalizing will do, including items with conflicts and open fulfillments. Worth checking when counting a warehouse that already holds stock or has orders in flight. (GET /api/stock-takes/{stockTake}/reconciliation-preview)

function.name: reverse_analysis
function.description: Check whether a closed stock take can still be reversed — returns can_reverse and which items have consumed FIFO layers. Run this before proposing a reversal. (GET /api/stock-takes/{stockTake}/reverse-analysis)

function.name: list_stock_take_documents
function.description: List the source / backup documents attached to a stock take — count sheets, the 3PL's spreadsheet, anomaly reports — newest first, each with its description, file_url, and uploaded_by. (GET /api/stock-takes/{stockTake}/documents)

function.name: upload_stock_take_document
function.description: Attach a source / backup document to a stock take. Multipart form-data, not JSON. Accepts pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, heic, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, csv, txt, html, htm, eml, msg, zip up to 20 MB. Always send a description saying what the file is, who supplied it, when, and what it does and doesn't cover. Not gated on status — a draft, open, or closed take can all receive attachments. Needs the inventory.count permission. (POST /api/stock-takes/{stockTake}/documents)

file.description: The document itself, sent as a multipart form-data field (curl -F).

description.description: What this file is, up to 2000 characters. Far roomier than the take's 255-char notes, and the thing that tells the next reader what they are looking at.
description.example: Photo of the handwritten count sheet from the Redbank floor, supplied by the warehouse manager 2026-07-30. Pages 1-2 of 2; page 2 covers the returns bay.

function.name: update_stock_take_document
function.description: Re-describe an attached document. Send description null to clear it. Used to mark a superseded anomaly report rather than deleting it. Needs the inventory.count permission. (PATCH /api/stock-takes/{stockTake}/documents/{document})

document.description: The document id. Must belong to this stock take, or the call 404s.

description.description: The new description, up to 2000 characters, or null to clear it.
description.example: Anomaly report v1 (SUPERSEDED by v2, 2026-08-04) — original 6 open items as filed 2026-07-31.

function.name: delete_stock_take_document
function.description: Remove an attachment — deletes the document, its link, and the stored file. Do not use this to replace a superseded anomaly report; post a new version and re-describe the old one. Needs the inventory.count permission. (DELETE /api/stock-takes/{stockTake}/documents/{document})

document.description: The document id. Must belong to this stock take, or the call 404s.

function.name: stream_stock_take_document
function.description: Stream an attachment's contents inline — the same URL the UI previews. Executable types (text/html, application/xhtml+xml, image/svg+xml) are served under a CSP sandbox with default-src 'none', so an uploaded HTML report must be fully self-contained: no JavaScript, no CDN fonts, no remote images. (GET /api/stock-takes/{stockTake}/documents/{document}/file)

document.description: The document id. Must belong to this stock take, or the call 404s.
